description: Angular component for selecting time aggregation interval options, including form controls, interval list management, and value propagation.

classes.name: GroupingIntervalOptionsComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor for selecting time interval options.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and updates the interval list.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Method for registering touch callback (empty implementation).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form group based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's value and updates the form controls.

methods.name: updateIntervalsList
